   <div id="docSubImgWrapper" data-setting="userPref-viewMode-pub-sjj-systemPreferred-html">

<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19019000-19019014" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/19/#v19019001-v19019014" target="_blank">Psalm 19</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Your glory, God, your mighty works abound,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">In skies above, their praise for you resounds.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">Creation speaks without a voice or word;</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">In all the earth, its message can be heard.</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">Creation speaks without a voice or word;</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">In all the earth, its message can be heard.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>True wisdom starts with wholesome fear of you</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">And guards our way in all we say and do.</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sp">Your wise commands enlighten young and old—</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sz">A treasure far exceeding finest gold.</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sp">Your wise commands enlighten young and old—</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sz">A treasure far exceeding finest gold.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3. </span>By knowing you, our life is not in vain,</p>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sz">And by your word, our life will be sustained.</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sp">The greatest honor anyone can gain</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sz">Will come to all who sanctify your name.</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sp">The greatest honor anyone can gain</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sz">Will come to all who sanctify your name.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19012006" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/12/#v19012006" target="_blank">Ps. 12:6;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19089007" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/89/#v19089007" target="_blank"> 89:7;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19144003" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/144/#v19144003" target="_blank"> 144:3;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="45001020" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/romans/1/#v45001020" target="_blank"> Rom. 1:20</a>.)</p>
</div>
